display_label: Asian Paints Limited — Decorative Paints & Home Décor

brand.executive_thesis: Asian Paints operates a highly responsive, direct-to-dealer supply chain that bypasses traditional wholesalers to service over 70,000 retail touchpoints. By leveraging advanced demand sensing and in-store tinting postponement, the company delivers multiple replenishments daily…

grounding_citations.title: Asian Paints Limited Official Brand Mark

terminology_highlights: Tinting Machine — Equipment placed at retail dealer stores to mix base paint with colorants on demand, enabling mass customization.
Direct-to-Dealer — Asian Paints' unique distribution model that eliminates wholesalers, supplying directly to retail hardware and paint shops.
Base Paint — Uncolored paint manufactured in bulk at central plants, which is later customized at the point of sale.
Depot — Regional warehousing hubs that receive bulk shipments from manufacturing plants and execute high-frequency last-mile deliveries to dealers.
